articles.title_original: At Trump meeting, Xi Jinping lays out terms to avoid US-China military conflict
articles.title_zh: At Trump meeting, Xi Jinping lays out terms to avoid US-China military conflict
facts_zh: Chinese president’s proposals for lessening tensions come amid period of intense competition between the two countries over AI and trade Xi Jinping has called for extensive cooperation with Washington to avoid the “Thucydides trap” that could put the US and China on a military collision course amid rising tensions over artificial intelligence, trade and Taiwan.

At the start of his summit meeting with Donald Trump in the White House, the Chinese president laid out terms for a mutual understanding that he said could steer the two competing superpowers away from future military conflict and on to a road of mutual gain.
The headline and text of this article were amended on 24 September 2026 to correct a misspelling of Xi Jinping.

articles.title_original: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
articles.title_zh: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
facts_zh:
Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
- Published
Pope Leo XIV embarks on a four-day visit to France on Friday, with the highpoint being a giant Mass attended by more than half a million people in central Paris.
For Saturday's afternoon celebration, an altar has been built on the Place de la Concorde and a large area around the Champs-Élysées sealed off by police.
Some 600,000 Catholic faithful are expected to cram the avenue up to the Arc de Triomphe and beyond.

articles.title_original: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
articles.title_zh: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
facts_zh:
Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
- Published
The Italian government has approved a ban on the burqa and niqab in schools, along with a limit on the share of pupils who speak little Italian in any one class.
A 30% cap will be imposed on children without Italian citizenship or poor knowledge of the Italian language in the first year of primary, middle and high school.
Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the measures as "common-sense tools that do not divide but really help to integrate".

all_titles.en: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class

articles.title_original: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
articles.title_zh: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
facts_zh:
Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
- Published
A priest has been killed and four other people injured in a knife attack in south-east Poland, officials have said.
A 31-year-old Ukrainian man was arrested after the stabbings on the grounds of a Catholic abbey in the town of Jarosław.

Polish President Karol Nawrocki said Thursday's attack "has shaken us all and demands a firm response from the state", while his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky said "we are shocked by this evil".

all_titles.en: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey

A resident told AFP news agency they heard a jet, followed by a large explosion and then a fire in the city.

articles.title_original: Greek PM urges UK PM to return Elgin Marbles permanently
articles.title_zh: Greek PM urges UK PM to return Elgin Marbles permanently
facts_zh:
Greek PM urges Burnham to return Elgin Marbles permanently
- Published
The Greek prime minister has called on Andy Burnham to find the "political will" to send the Parthenon sculptures back to Greece.
Kyriakos Mitsotakis wrote in the Guardian that returning the classical treasures, also known as the Elgin Marbles in the UK, would "send a powerful signal" but would require "courage".
The sculptures have been on display in the British Museum since the 19th Century, though Greece has long disputed the legality of their removal.

articles.title_original: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
articles.title_zh: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
facts_zh:
105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
- Published
German prosecutors are investigating a man aged 105 over allegations that he was an accessory to multiple counts of murder at a Nazi prisoner of war camp in World War Two.
The suspect is alleged to have been a camp guard at Stalag 326 VI K in Senne in northwestern Germany.
A similar case had also been under way involving a second former camp guard at Senne, Dortmund public prosecutor Sonja Frodermann said in a statement.
